title: Flat, locally finitely presented, separated, locally quasi-finite morphisms with universally bounded fibres are finite locally free on a finite stratification (Stacks 07RY)
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme] which is flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], locally of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], separated [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and locally quasi-finite [pqf-def-quasifinite], and whose fibres are universally bounded: there is an integer $n\ge0$ such that for every $s\in S$ the fibre $X_s=X\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ (fibre product [def-pc-fibre-product], residue field $\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field]) is a finite scheme over $\kappa(s)$, $X_s=\operatorname{Spec}B_s$ with $B_s$ a finite $\kappa(s)$-algebra, of degree $\dim_{\kappa(s)}B_s\le n$ (the integer $n$ bounds the degrees of the fibres of $f$ [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound], Stacks Morphisms, Definition 03J4). Then there exist closed subsets $\emptyset=Z_{-1}\subseteq Z_0\subseteq Z_1\subseteq\cdots\subseteq Z_n=S$ such that, with $S_r=Z_r\setminus Z_{r-1}$ for $0\le r\le n$ and $S_r=\emptyset$ for $r>n$, the sets $S_r$ are pairwise disjoint with union $S$, and the following universal property holds: for every morphism of schemes $g:T\to S$ and every integer $r\ge0$, the projection $X\times_ST\to T$ is finite locally free of degree $r$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free] if and only if $g(T)\subseteq S_r$ (as sets). (Stacks Project, More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY.)

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, with its proof (induction on the bound n; uses Lemma lemma-etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part, Morphisms Lemmas finite-flat and base-change-universally-bounded, Descent Lemma descending-property-finite-locally-free); Morphisms Definition Tag 03J4 for 'universally bounded'

proof.text: *Notation; base change keeps the hypotheses and the bound.* For a morphism $f:X\to S$ whose fibres are finite over the residue fields write $\delta_f(s)=\dim_{\kappa(s)}\Gamma(X_s,\mathcal O_{X_s})$ for $s\in S$ (the degree of $X_s$ over $\kappa(s)$, [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound]); for our $f$, $\delta_f(s)\le n$ for all $s$. Let $g:T\to S$ be any morphism and $f_T:X_T=X\times_ST\to T$ the base change. Then $f_T$ is flat [lem-weil-pbc-flat-morphism-base-change], locally of finite presentation [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-morphism-permanence] (3), separated and locally quasi-finite [lem-weil-pbc-separated-lqf-base-change], and for every $t\in T$ the fibre $(X_T)_t$ is finite over $\kappa(t)$ with $\delta_{f_T}(t)=\delta_f(g(t))$ [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-base-change]. In particular $n$ bounds the degrees of the fibres of $f_T$ (Stacks: Morphisms, Lemma 03J7), and all integers $r$ for which some nonempty $X_T\to T$ is finite locally free of degree $r$ are $\le n$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, first paragraph ('By Morphisms, Lemma 03J7 we see that any base change has degrees of fibres bounded by n also')

proof.text: *Claim, set-up at a point of maximal degree.* Claim: let $f:X\to S$ be any morphism which is flat, locally of finite presentation, separated and locally quasi-finite, and let $m\ge0$ be an integer bounding the degrees of its fibres; then $S_m:=\{s\in S:\delta_f(s)=m\}$ is open in $S$ and $X\times_SS_m\to S_m$ is finite locally free of degree $m$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. (Steps 2-6 prove the claim.) Fix $s\in S_m$. The fibre $X_s$ is finite over $\kappa(s)$, so $X_s\to\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ has finite fibres [lem-weil-pbc-finite-closed-map-finite-fibres] (2), i.e. $X_s$ is a finite set; the first projection is a homeomorphism of $X_s$ onto $f^{-1}(\{s\})$ [def-pc-scheme-fibre], so $f^{-1}(\{s\})$ is finite and $X_s$ has at most finitely many isolated points. As $f$ is locally of finite presentation it is locally of finite type (a finitely presented algebra is finitely generated: [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation], [def-weil-finite-type-morphism]), and it is separated. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part] there are an elementary etale neighbourhood $\varphi:(U,u)\to(S,s)$ ($\varphi$ etale [def-weil-etale-morphism]) and a decomposition $U\times_SX=W\sqcup V$ into disjoint open subschemes with $V\to U$ finite and $W_u=\emptyset$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, second paragraph ('Choose an elementary etale morphism (U,u) -> (S,s) and a decomposition U x_S X = W amalg V as in Lemma 02LP')

proof.text: *$V\to U$ is finite locally free.* The projection $U\times_SX\to U$ is the base change of $f$ along $\varphi$, hence flat and locally of finite presentation (step 1). $V$ is an open subscheme of $U\times_SX$: for $v\in V$ the local ring $\mathcal O_{V,v}$ is $\mathcal O_{U\times_SX,v}$, so $V\to U$ is flat at $v$ [def-weil-flat-morphism], and the affine opens around $v$ with finitely presented ring maps given by [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] may be shrunk to standard opens $D(a)$ inside $V$ (a localization $B_a$ of a finitely presented $R$-algebra $B$ is finitely presented, $B_a=B[x]/(ax-1)$), so $V\to U$ is locally of finite presentation. Being also finite, $V\to U$ is finite locally free [def-pc-finite-locally-free] (finite, flat and locally of finite presentation; this is Stacks Morphisms, Lemma 02KB, which here is the definition).

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, second paragraph ('Since V -> U is finite, flat, and locally of finite presentation, we see that V -> U is finite locally free, see Morphisms, Lemma 02KB')

proof.text: *Shrinking $U$; the degree at $u$ is $m$.* By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-free-degree-locally-constant] the degree function $\delta_{V\to U}$ is locally constant; let $d=\delta_{V\to U}(u)$ and $U'=\delta_{V\to U}^{-1}(d)$, an open (and closed) neighbourhood of $u$ over which the preimage of $U'$ in $V$ is finite locally free of degree $d$ (Stacks Morphisms, Lemma 04MH). Replace $U$ by $U'$, and $W,V$ by their preimages $W',V'$ under $U'\times_SX\to U'$; by [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product] $U'\times_SX$ is the preimage of $U'$ in $U\times_SX$ and $U'\times_SX=W'\sqcup V'$ with $V'\to U'$ finite locally free of degree $d$, $W'_u=\emptyset$; $U'\to S$ is etale as the composite of the open immersion $U'\to U$ and $\varphi$ [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (1), (2), and $\kappa(u)$ is unchanged. The fibre $(U'\times_SX)_u$ has degree $\delta_f(s)=m$ (step 1, for the base change along $U'\to S$, $u\mapsto s$). It is the disjoint union of its open subschemes $W'_u=\emptyset$ and $V'_u$ (preimages of $W'$, $V'$; fibres by pasting of cartesian squares [def-pc-fibre-product] with [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product]), so it equals $V'_u$, whose degree is $d$. Hence $d=m$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, second paragraph ('After shrinking U ... we may assume V -> U is finite locally free of some degree d, see Morphisms, Lemma 04MH. As u -> s and W_u is empty we see that d = n')

proof.text: *$W'=\emptyset$ and $\varphi(U')\subseteq S_m$; $S_m$ is open.* Let $u'\in U'$ and $s'=\varphi(u')$. The fibre $F=(U'\times_SX)_{u'}$ is finite over $\kappa(u')$ of degree $\delta_f(s')\le m$ [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-base-change]. It is the disjoint union of its open subschemes $F_W$, $F_V$, the preimages of $W'$, $V'$, which are the fibres of $W'\to U'$ and $V'\to U'$ at $u'$ ([lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product], pasting [def-pc-fibre-product]); by the sheaf axiom for the cover $F=F_W\sqcup F_V$, $\Gamma(F,\mathcal O_F)=\Gamma(F_W,\mathcal O)\times\Gamma(F_V,\mathcal O)$, so $\delta_f(s')=\dim\Gamma(F_W,\mathcal O)+m$ (as $V'\to U'$ has degree $m$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free]). Hence $\Gamma(F_W,\mathcal O)=0$, so $F_W=\emptyset$ (in a nonempty scheme $1\ne0$ in some local ring, hence in $\Gamma$), and $\delta_f(s')=m$. Since every point of $W'$ lies in the fibre over its image in $U'$, $W'=\emptyset$: $U'\times_SX=V'\to U'$ is finite locally free of degree $m$, and $\varphi(U')\subseteq S_m$. $\varphi(U')$ is open [lem-weil-pbc-etale-morphism-open-map] and contains $s$. As $s\in S_m$ was arbitrary, $S_m$ is the union of these opens, hence open.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, second paragraph ('Since n is the maximum degree of a fibre we see that W is empty! ... Im(U -> S) which is an open neighbourhood of s (Morphisms, Lemma 03WT)')

proof.text: *Descent to $S_m$; end of the claim.* Give $S_m$ its open subscheme structure; $X\times_SS_m=f^{-1}(S_m)\to S_m$ [lem-weil-pbc-open-preimage-fibre-product]. For every $s\in S_m$ let $\varphi_s:U'_s\to S$ be the etale morphism of steps 2-5; its image lies in $S_m$, so it factors as $U'_s\xrightarrow{\psi_s}S_m\hookrightarrow S$ [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-factors-through-open-subscheme], and $\psi_s$ is etale because $\varphi_s$ and the open immersion $S_m\to S$ are [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation] (1), (3). The images $\psi_s(U'_s)\ni s$ cover $S_m$. By pasting cartesian squares [def-pc-fibre-product], $(X\times_SS_m)\times_{S_m}U'_s=X\times_SU'_s\to U'_s$, which is finite locally free of degree $m$ by step 5. By [lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-free-degree-etale-descent], $X\times_SS_m\to S_m$ is finite locally free of degree $m$. This proves the claim.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, second paragraph ('By Descent, Lemma 02VO we conclude that X -> S is finite locally free of degree n over Im(U -> S) ... This proves the claim')

proof.text: *The sets $Z_r$ are closed (induction on $n$).* For $r\ge-1$ put $Z_r=\{s\in S:\delta_f(s)\le r\}$, so $\emptyset=Z_{-1}\subseteq Z_0\subseteq\cdots\subseteq Z_n=S$. We show by induction on $n$: for every $f$ satisfying the hypotheses with $n$ bounding its fibre degrees, every $Z_r$ is closed in $S$. If $n=0$, $Z_{-1}=\emptyset$ and $Z_r=S$ for $r\ge0$. Let $n\ge1$. $Z_r=S$ for $r\ge n$, and $Z_{n-1}=S\setminus S_n$ is closed by the claim (with $m=n$). Let $S'$ be the reduced induced closed subscheme on $Z_{n-1}$, $i:S'\to S$ its closed immersion with $i(S')=Z_{n-1}$ [lem-weil-pbc-reduced-induced-closed-subscheme] [def-weil-closed-immersion], and $f':X'=X\times_SS'\to S'$. By step 1 $f'$ is flat, locally of finite presentation, separated, locally quasi-finite, and $\delta_{f'}(s')=\delta_f(i(s'))\le n-1$ for $s'\in S'$, so $n-1$ bounds its fibre degrees [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound]. By induction $Z'_r=\{s'\in S':\delta_{f'}(s')\le r\}$ is closed in $S'$ for every $r$; for $r\le n-1$, $i(Z'_r)=Z_r\cap Z_{n-1}=Z_r$, and $i$ is a homeomorphism onto the closed subset $Z_{n-1}$, so $Z_r$ is closed in $S$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, first paragraph ('We will prove the lemma by induction on n. The base case is n = 0 which is obvious') and third paragraph ('Let S' = S minus S_n endowed with the reduced induced scheme structure ... By induction we find a stratification S' = S_0 amalg ... amalg S_{n-1}')

proof.text: *The strata.* For $0\le r\le n$, $S_r:=Z_r\setminus Z_{r-1}=\{s:\delta_f(s)=r\}$, and for $r>n$, $S_r=\emptyset=\{s:\delta_f(s)=r\}$ since $\delta_f\le n$. These sets are pairwise disjoint with union $S$, since $\delta_f(s)$ is one integer in $[0,n]$. (For $r=n$ this is the open set of the claim; for $r<n$ it is the stratum the induction of step 7 produces on $S'$, since $\delta_{f'}=\delta_f\circ i$.)

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, statement and third paragraph ('We claim that S = coprod_{r=0..n} S_r works')

proof.text: *Universal property, 'only if'.* Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism and $r\ge0$ such that $X\times_ST\to T$ is finite locally free of degree $r$. For $t\in T$ the fibre $(X_T)_t$ has degree $r$ by [def-pc-finite-locally-free] and degree $\delta_f(g(t))$ by [lem-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-base-change]; so $\delta_f(g(t))=r$, i.e. $g(t)\in S_r$ (step 8). Hence $g(T)\subseteq S_r$; in particular $T=\emptyset$ if $r>n$.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RY (lemma-stratify-flat-fp-lqf-universally-bounded), line 12761, proof, third paragraph ('Let g: T -> S be a morphism of schemes and assume that X x_S T -> T is finite locally free of degree r ... we see that g(T) = g(T_red) is contained in S_r'); argued directly from the fibre degrees, see step 10

proof.text: *Universal property, 'if'.* Let $g:T\to S$ with $g(T)\subseteq S_r$. By step 1, $f_T:X_T\to T$ is flat, locally of finite presentation, separated and locally quasi-finite, and $\delta_{f_T}(t)=\delta_f(g(t))=r$ for every $t\in T$; so $r$ bounds the degrees of the fibres of $f_T$ [def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound] and $\{t\in T:\delta_{f_T}(t)=r\}=T$. The claim (steps 2-6) applied to $f_T$ with $m=r$ gives that $X_T\times_TT=X_T\to T$ is finite locally free of degree $r$ [def-pc-finite-locally-free]. (Stacks argues here, for $r<n$, through $T_{red}\to S'$, the universal homeomorphism $X\times_ST_{red}\to X\times_ST$ and More on Morphisms, Lemma 02LS; applying the claim to the base change $f_T$, whose fibre degrees are all equal to $r$, gives the same conclusion directly, and also covers the 'only if' direction of step 9 without passing to $T_{red}$.)

Finally, the degree is r as all the fibres have degree r'), rewritten by the worker through the claim of the second paragraph

split_report.summary: Statement checked against Stacks 07RY (more-morphisms.tex line 12761) and kept; it now names the 03J4 node def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound (added to stmt_deps). Proof in ten steps along the Stacks proof: base change keeps the hypotheses and the fibre degrees (new unsplit nodes lem-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-base-change for 03J5/03J7 and lem-weil-pbc-separated-lqf-base-change for 01KU/01TM); the claim that the maximal-degree locus S_m is open with X over it finite locally free of degree m, via the etale splitting 02LP (new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-etale-splits-off-quasi-finite-part), 02KB (the definition of finite locally free here), 04MH (existing lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-free-degree-locally-constant), the degree count on fibres (W empty, written out by the sheaf axiom), 03WT (existing leaf) and 02VO (new unsplit node lem-weil-pbc-finite-locally-free-degree-etale-descent, for etale coverings); closedness of Z_r by induction on n on the reduced induced S' (existing nodes). The universal property is proved from the claim applied to the base change X_T -> T (all fibre degrees equal r), instead of Stacks' T_red / universal homeomorphism / 02LS route, which needs no further node. Source slips: Stacks writes 'S minus S_d' for 'S minus S_n', and 'the claim' is stated for the given n but is used, in the converse, for the base change. Tags 07RY, 02LP, 02KB, 04MH, 03J7, 03J5, 02VO, 022C, 03WT, 01KU, 01TM verified in tags/tags. Mathlib: no stratification, no etale splitting beyond the one-point exists_etale_isCompl_of_quasiFiniteAt, no descent of IsFinite/Flat, no fibre-degree base change beyond FlatRank for finite flat morphisms.

reviewed.note: 10 steps following Stacks 07RY: base change keeps hypotheses and fibre degrees (new nodes for 01KU(3)/01TM(2) and for 03J7 as fibre-degree invariance); the claim (S_m open, X over S_m finite locally free of degree m) via the elementary etale neighbourhood splitting off the finite part (new unsplit 02LP node), local constancy of the degree (04MH node), additivity of fibre degrees forcing W = 0 and openness (03WT), etale descent of 'finite locally free of degree d' (new unsplit 02VO node); Z_r closed by induction on n with the reduced induced structure; universal property both ways by applying the claim to the base change f_T (L checked: the claim is proved for arbitrary f with the hypotheses, so this replaces Stacks' route through T_red and 02LS). Statement gained the citation of def-weil-pbc-fibre-degree-bound. Stacks misprint S \ S_d for S \ S_n.

lean.statement: theorem exists_flat_fp_lqf_bounded_stratification {X S : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) [Flat f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [IsSeparated f] (h_lqf : IsLocallyQuasiFinite f) (n : ℕ) (hn : BoundsFiberDegrees f n) : ∃ Z : ℕ → Set S, Z 0 = ∅ ∧ (∀ r : ℕ, IsClosed (Z r)) ∧ Monotone Z ∧ Z (n + 1) = Set.univ ∧ Pairwise (fun r t : ℕ => Disjoint (Z (r + 1) \ Z r) (Z (t + 1) \ Z t)) ∧ (⋃ r : ℕ, Z (r + 1) \ Z r) = Set.univ ∧ (∀ (T : Scheme.{u}) (g : T ⟶ S) (r : ℕ), (pullback.snd f g).IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfDegree r ↔ Set.range g ⊆ Z (r + 1) \ Z r)
